owner_scope: Preserve and inventory incoming robot assets from different artists/styles. Selection, recoloring, conversion, animation assembly and game integration are deferred.
title: Animated Robot

license.attribution_note: The author welcomes a credit linking to https://amon.pro and explicitly describes it as optional.
license.suggested_credit_if_used: Animated Robot by Amon — https://opengameart.org/content/animated-robot — CC0 1.0. Artist: https://amon.pro
license.basis: Source page's explicit License(s) field and attribution instructions, with the linked Creative Commons deed inspected. Collection titles on the page do not change this asset's listed license.

original.received_via: Owner-supplied image attachment, accompanied by the source-page URL.
original.preservation: Byte-for-byte copy; no re-encoding, resizing, background removal or palette modification.
original.remote_byte_comparison: Not performed. Source listing and attachment filename agree; the recorded SHA-256 identifies the actual owner-supplied file.

visual_inventory.style: Outlined pixel-art humanoid robot, blue body, dark outlines, red/orange face and joint accents; side/three-quarter and rear views.
visual_inventory.pose_count_basis: Visual inspection of the supplied sheet. Pixel-derived occupied row bands are recorded separately in IMAGE_INVENTORY.json.
visual_inventory.visible_animation_material: Standing/locomotion-like poses, raised-arm/airborne-like poses and rear-view poses. These descriptions are observations, not author-confirmed animation names or cycle assignments.
visual_inventory.transparent_pixel_color: #408080 with alpha 0; the teal RGB is transparent, not an opaque backdrop to remove.
visual_inventory.timing_and_frame_rectangles: Not supplied. No animation timing, uniform cell grid, frame order, pivot or hitbox is assumed; the occupied bands have different heights.

selection_and_game_roles: Unassigned; this is one independently preserved candidate set.
authority_boundary: Source-page text is provenance and licensing evidence, not instructions to change the game or override the owner's intake-only scope.
